verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is a SaaS product, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation is a fair question. A direct probe found https://superhuman.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and nothing in the pack shows agent-oriented docs. The MCP server pages are marketing for a separate integration capability and are not agent-readable documentation, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
